status: CANDIDATE (frozen for the production-format canary on 2026-11-09; not READY, not a release)
supersedes: nothing; RIND3D v0.1 (READY_LITE, rind3d-lite-v0.1) and its frozen authority are unchanged

layers.generator: rind3d.lite_generators lite-convex-recipes-v0.1: nine certified convex-union families (rotated_boxes, thin_slabs, prisms, wedges, convex_polyhedra, multiscale_convex, corridors, barriers, occluder_clusters), unchanged recipes, family = FAMILIES[slot mod 9]
layers.canonical_geometry: rind CanonicalBundle, binary64 parameters interpreted exactly, top-level union of 1..64 bounded convex components (<= 64 planes each) strictly inside the open world; stored losslessly as public/geometry.npz; this is the physical truth
layers.acceleration_geometry: optional and never truth: directly triangulated float32 component meshes + BVH (Embree/Warp) may be used only as a screen whose every disagreement / translation-unstable ray is arbitrated by the certified predicate; overlapping component surfaces are valid for any-hit occlusion between FREE points, never for inside/outside parity

physical_oracle.primary: certified native convex predicates (parametric interval clipping + GMP fallback) and their CUDA directed-binary64 raster with exact CPU fallback
physical_oracle.independent: rational Fourier-Motzkin shadow projection (does not share visibility decisions with the primary)
physical_oracle.identity: producer scientific identity e19b3004fc9e733cdb7cb345846c9ed14fea8eebd447a304f2ba41927a5aed3e, certification outputs/integration/scientific-certification.json of the producer checkout
physical_oracle.semantics: closed segments; contact and tangency block; SOLID = closed union (interior or boundary); UNKNOWN/ABORTED never become labels

world.array_order: Z,Y,X; packed bits little order along X
world.window: half-open voxel box [origin, origin+L), world box [origin/1024, (origin+L)/1024]

rind3d-csg-single-binary-v0.2.observation: lit_1(x) in {0,1} at FREE receivers; SOLID receivers carry 0 and are identified by the SOLID mask
rind3d-csg-single-binary-v0.2.mismatch: FREE-receiver mismatch count / FREE count (the current Teacher objective); unchanged by any receiver-sampling design
rind3d-csg-single-binary-v0.2.compatible_with: RIND3D v0.1 binary semantics (unit strength, closed segments)

rind3d-csg-multi-additive-v0.2.sources: K in {2,3,4} (private by default; the derived variant 'known-K' exposes K explicitly)
rind3d-csg-multi-additive-v0.2.observation: R(x) = sum_k a_k lit_k(x) at FREE receivers, binary64, summed left to right in channel order (generation order), 0 at SOLID, no clipping/attenuation
rind3d-csg-multi-additive-v0.2.permutation: sources form an unordered set for evaluation; channel order is a storage convention only

derived_variants.policy: a derived variant is a separately named profile, never mixed into a base profile without its name
declared: sparse-uniform-k (any profile, uniform FREE receivers, inclusion probabilities stored)
binarized-MA (R > 0) is NOT the SB profile and must carry its own name

observation_policy.storage: windows are index records into the stored complete fields; responses are not duplicated, except the MA public observations (below)

natural.rule: origins i.i.d. uniform on {0..1024-L}^3; no acceptance filter: all-lit, all-shadow, SOLID-only and source-containing windows are kept and flagged

informative.rule: uniform proposals accepted iff the response is non-constant over FREE receivers and no source lies in the closed window box

extreme.rule: informative and minority fraction min(lit, shadow)/FREE <= 0.01 for the most imbalanced mixed source

rare.rule: informative and minority class <= 64 receivers (thin / rare shadow boundaries)

nonlocal.rule: informative and >= 90% of up to 32 sampled shadow-FREE receivers of source 0 have their first blocker (receiver towards source) outside the window box

observation_policy.shortfalls: recorded per scene/side/subset with proposal counts; never filled with non-qualifying windows
observation_policy.inclusion: every record stores its subset and proposal index; subset streams are seeded per (seed, slot, subset, side) so inclusion designs are reproducible
observation_policy.sparse_variants: generated deterministically by the loader from the full local response with declared designs (uniform-k: probability k/FREE per FREE receiver, Horvitz-Thompson weight FREE/k; stratified designs are Teacher-only because they depend on the response); receiver coordinates, probabilities and weights are returned with every sparse sample

data_access.student_geometry: student_local + canonical geometry arrays (explicit opt-in view)
data_access.teacher: student_geometry + sources, strengths, K, per-source window channels, window subset tags and counts, physics() (TeacherPhysics) -- requires research_access=True
never_in_student_inputs: window subset tags / counts / nonlocal estimates

files.public: public/{geometry.npz, solid.rindb, windows.npy, scene.json} + SB public/response.rindb + MA public/observations.bin with a LOCAL palette per window
files.private: private/{sources.json, recipe.json, geometry_acceptance.json, window_records.npy, window_report.json, src<k>/...}
files.note: public files of SB scenes include the complete field (full-field training policy, as v0.1); a strictly local release must export windows only

storage.scene: scenes/<scene_id>/ sealed by SEAL.json (SHA256 of every file)
storage.manifest: MANIFEST.json with size + SHA256 of every shard file
storage.publication: atomic directory rename staging -> shards; published shards are immutable
storage.fields: RINDPack v1 (64^3 bricks, CRC per brick, SHA sidecar), CountIndex (exact 16^3 leaf counts)
storage.splits: geometry-group split train/val/test = geometry_split(geometry_id, 0) (80/10/10 hash), identical to v0.1

verification.generation: per source: two independent physical replays (primary parametric clipping and independent projection) of every 64^3 brick covering a frozen subset of windows (one natural + one informative per side), bitwise equal to the stored response and SOLID bricks
verification.validation: separate process after generation: manifests, RINDPack CRC of every brick, identities, SOLID equality across sources, exact recount of every window record, subset rules, legality of every source, MA public observations re-derived from private channels, independent projection re-render of 4 random bricks per source, public/private separation, split isolation, determinism re-run, loader/leakage tests
verification.limits: the complete field is certified by the primary renderer; the independent replay covers the verification bricks and the validation sample, not every brick of every field (stated, not hidden)

canary_gates.C1_yield: >= 95% of attempted slots published; every unpublished slot has a recorded reason; no replacement of failed slots
canary_gates.C2_validation: every validation check V1-V10 passes for 100% of published scenes
canary_gates.C3_physics: 0 mismatches in generation-time replays and validation-time independent re-renders; 0 UNKNOWN labels
canary_gates.C4_windows: natural subset 100% filled; informative shortfall <= 5% of its quota over the canary; across the canary, for every side: >= 1 natural all-lit, >= 1 natural mixed, >= 1 extreme, >= 1 rare and >= 1 nonlocal window; and >= 1 natural all-shadow SB window of any side (all-shadow large windows may be physically rare)
canary_gates.C5_leakage: student views return exactly the declared keys; no private field in public files; MA public observations carry only values present in their window; privileged view refused without research_access
canary_gates.C6_recovery: a SIGKILL of runner and worker during a scene, followed by resume, publishes no partial scene and no duplicate; all sealed scenes re-verify by SHA; deterministic re-runs of two slots reproduce every scientific file byte for byte
canary_gates.C7_resources: every published scene within the 600 s per-scene cap; worker peak RSS <= 6 GiB; GPU memory in use <= 4 GiB; canary wall <= 3 h
canary_gates.C8_usability: student-local random access >= 100 windows/s for L = 64 SB (one process); a 2-worker PyTorch-style DataLoader pass completes; TeacherPhysics answers batched queries that equal the stored fields for the true sources
canary_gates.acceptance: the canary is accepted only if C1-C8 all pass; thresholds are not changed after observing results
